_note: PRE-REGISTERED before prospective evidence accumulation. Do not modify after activation boundary. Standards must be set before observing canary outcomes.
live_ready_definition: NOT implied by SEAL. Requires separate live-risk/capital authorization event.

S0.name: Activation integrity
S0.description: Immutable activation record exists, all required fields present, SHA256 checksum verified, epoch ACTIVE.
S0.pass_condition: Verified at activation. No re-check required unless artifact mismatch detected.

S1.name: Prospective prediction lineage
S1.description: At least 1 natural post-activation prediction observed with full lineage intact.
S1.pass_condition: prediction.activated_at > epoch.activated_at AND prediction.artifact_sha256 == activation_record.model_artifact_sha256 AND prediction.epoch_id == activation_record.epoch_id AND prediction.paper_run_id == activation_record.paper_run_id AND prediction.feature_schema_version == activation_record.feature_schema_hash

S2.name: Filter behavior
S2.description: Natural S3 ACCEPT and natural S3 REJECT both observed. If one class has not occurred by end of observation window, classify as TIME-ACCUMULATING, not FAIL.
S2.pass_condition: natural S3 ACCEPT observed AND natural S3 REJECT observed
S2.time_accumulating_condition: If one class not observed in window: record as TIME-ACCUMULATING. Does not block seal automatically. Requires human review.
S2.note: Absence of one class is informative (threshold may be aggressive) but is not a failure mode of the canary itself.

S3.name: Execution semantics
S3.description: At least 1 natural executable decision, 1 paper reservation/fill. P4 serialization behavior verified correct.
S3.pass_condition: natural executable decision count >= 1 AND paper fill count >= 1 AND P4 concurrent-limit and cooldown behavior correct
S3.suppression_note: P4 suppression (overlap/capacity) is informative if observed but NOT required for seal. If market does not create contention in observation window, NOT_OBSERVED != FAIL.

S4.name: Outcome semantics
S4.description: At least 1 natural E4 position close observed. Exit reason (TP/SL/timeout) and realized outcome linked end-to-end from signal to fill to outcome.
S4.pass_condition: natural E4 close count >= 1 AND exit_reason in {TP, SL, TIMEOUT, COLLISION} AND outcome.prediction_id links back to prediction AND outcome.fill_id links back to fill

S5.name: Recovery and idempotency
S5.description: Restart/recovery observed or controlled non-trading restart test passes. No duplicate prediction, decision, fill, or outcome records.
S5.pass_condition: restart_recovery_observed == true OR controlled_restart_test_pass == true AND duplicate_count == 0
S5.note: Controlled non-trading restart (kill/restart runner, verify idempotency) is an acceptable substitute for natural outage recovery.

S6.name: Integrity
S6.description: Artifact checksum unchanged since activation. Runtime contract unchanged. Zero lineage mismatches. Zero unexplained quarantines. Zero FAILED_INTERNAL events.
S6.pass_condition: artifact_sha256 == activation_record.model_artifact_sha256 AND runtime_contract_hash == activation_record.runtime_contract_hash AND lineage_mismatch_count == 0 AND unexplained_quarantine_count == 0 AND FAILED_INTERNAL_count == 0
S6.note: S6 is a continuous gate. Any breach triggers immediate review and may block seal.

S7.name: Stability
S7.description: Prospective collection runs for the predeclared observation window without semantic or runtime incident.
S7.observation_window: NOT YET DECLARED — must be declared before seal review, independently of observed outcomes

event_triggers.description: Return to validate only when a real event fires. Do not poll on schedule.

prohibited_actions.description: The following actions are prohibited during canary accumulation period.
items: Modifying model weights, coefficients, or preprocessing parameters
Changing S3 thresholds for BTC, ETH, or BNB
Changing exit contract (E4 tp_bps, sl_bps, max_hold_bars)
Creating synthetic trades to accelerate execution/outcome evidence
Retroactively relaxing seal criteria based on observed canary behavior
Enabling live trading before SEAL + separate live-risk authorization

status_vocabulary.NOT_YET_OBSERVED: Event has not occurred. Does not imply failure.
status_vocabulary.TIME_ACCUMULATING: One class of a binary event not yet observed within window. Informative, requires human review at seal time. Does not auto-block seal.
status_vocabulary.FAILED_TO_OCCUR: Event required but window elapsed without observation. Blocks seal.
status_vocabulary.ACCUMULATING: Collection in progress, no terminal condition reached.
